Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: square photographic background for the STAŻ internship card in a developer portfolio.
Input image: reference for the existing realistic photographic style, blue shadow palette, office realism and quality; recompose its scene to make mentoring the clear subject.
Primary request: two adult software developers learning and collaborating in an ordinary modern office, an experienced mentor explaining a simple system sketch on a small whiteboard while a younger colleague beside him listens and follows along with an open laptop on the meeting table. Show both people from a natural three-quarter side angle, their gestures and shared discussion clearly visible. The collaboration and whiteboard should dominate, NOT rows of code on giant monitors.
Composition: one square full-bleed photograph, medium-wide framing. People, whiteboard and laptop in the upper 80%; realistic desk and room continue to the bottom so the site can apply its own gradient. Leave the top-left unobstructed by faces for a date overlay.
Lighting and mood: credible late-evening office, cool navy/blue ambient shadows with restrained warm soft light. More social and welcoming than the solitary work card, photographic and candid rather than staged.
Constraints: retain the photographic realism and cool cohesive palette of the reference, change the setting and pose to emphasize mentoring. Two adults only. No border, no card UI, no titles, no labels, no watermark, no readable text. Whiteboard may contain only simple unlabeled boxes and connecting lines. No stars, nebula, fantasy scenery, holograms or exaggerated neon.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: square photographic background for the PRACA professional work card in a developer portfolio.
Input image: reference for the existing realistic photographic quality and restrained midnight-blue colors; recompose the workspace so it is visibly different from a mentoring or learning scene.
Primary request: a single independent software engineer at a meticulously organized, finished professional workstation in a quiet contemporary studio at night. View from a wider three-quarter side angle instead of directly behind a person. A premium ultrawide monitor on an articulated arm displays a polished application interface with a small code pane, with a vertically oriented secondary screen and a closed docked laptop. An ergonomic chair, clean dark desk, compact keyboard and understated desktop equipment. Show the engineer working alone, in a plain dark professional shirt, with the refined workstation and productive focus as the main subject.
Composition: one square full-bleed photograph. Desk, screens and the single engineer occupy the upper 80%; realistic desk and room extend to the bottom. Top-left provides quiet darker space for a date overlay. Background is a normal dim city window and dark uncluttered studio, no office coworkers, whiteboard or hanging pendant lamps.
Lighting and mood: cool steel/navy-blue screen light with one subtle neutral warm desk light; more clean, focused and self-sufficient than the internship scene. Real camera image, believable materials and natural anatomy.
Constraints: preserve the reference's realistic photography and restrained palette; change the camera angle, uncluttered equipment and clothing so it feels like a distinct professional setup. Exactly one adult. No border, no card UI, titles, labels, watermark or readable text. No stars, nebula, science fiction, holograms, fantasy scenery or rainbow RGB lighting.
